premises.statement: Raw opportunity account_id values already satisfy the required ID-format and raw.account membership checks, so projecting them directly requires no nullification.
premises.alternative: The contract requires nullify_field when account_id fails either "account_id IS NULL OR account_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{15,18}$'" or "account_id IS NULL OR account_id IN (SELECT id FROM raw.account)".

premises.statement: The combination of contact_id, _fivetran_start, and _fivetran_end distinguishes every retained contact history record that requires a distinct history_unique_key.
premises.evidence_of_dependence: md5(concat_ws('|', coalesce(cast(contact_id as varchar), ''), coalesce(cast(_fivetran_start as varchar), ''), coalesce(cast(_fivetran_end as varchar), ''))) as history_unique_key
premises.reason: Distinct retained versions sharing these inputs would receive the same key despite the contract's uniqueness constraint.
